pre_t1_operational_history_policy.pre_genesis_no_lifecycle_at_t1: For an exact subject with independently established PRE_GENESIS origin, the initial Relay state may contain no Relay lifecycle at T1. This describes the Relay operational starting state only; it does not assert that no pre-T1 lifecycle activity occurred.
pre_t1_operational_history_policy.selected_record_rule: Any pre-T1 lifecycle, governance, result, or canonical-promotion record selected for import requires exact qualifying evidence and complete causal closure.
pre_t1_operational_history_policy.snapshot_coverage: Each included Slice must be represented by an exact imported lifecycle chain or by the accepted B0 Rev3 PRE_GENESIS/no-Relay-lifecycle-at-T1 framing.
pre_t1_operational_history_policy.unselected_history: Pre-T1 operational history not selected for import is neither inferred nor synthesized. Its omission makes no claim that the activity or record never existed.
